IP and Confidentiality are modular covenants; ordering them in reverse produces zero legal incoherence.

Users and Fee Schedule are commutative covenants; perfectly valid order.
Exhibit A Statement of Work inverted before Section 2 Scope; breaks explicit cross-reference and lifecycle.

Audit Rights and Warranty Disclaimers are independent risk covenants; order is legally neutral.
